clue.text: Church member finds its head an attractive person

parts.note: an arm is a member, or limb, of the body
the head of the Church of England is the monarch, here ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A churchgoer discovers that the person leading the congregation is rather charming.
explanation.walkthrough: The Queen, ER, is Supreme Governor of the Church of England, so 'its head' points back to the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with charm who attracts others is called a charmer, a synonym for a captivating person.

clue.text: Monkey born among non-whites having no right

indicators.note: born goes among the other letters
the letters lose the one named

parts.note: coloureds or 'colours' as opposed to whites in laundry

explanation.surface: A monkey born among coloured animals.
explanation.walkthrough: In laundry, coloureds are washed apart from whites, so 'non-whites' is COLOURS; 'having no' removes R to leave COLOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: The colobus is an African leaf-eating monkey.

clue.text: Morning Star circle's missing gauge

parts.note: AM stands for ante meridiem, morning

indicators.note: missing tells us a piece is dropped from the word before it

parts.note: a meteor is a shooting star
O is shaped like a circle

explanation.surface: A newspaper whose circulation gauge has gone missing.
explanation.walkthrough: The Morning Star is a British newspaper, a misdirection; 'missing' removes O from METEOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An instrument measuring electric current in amperes is a gauge.

clue.text: Resident alien removed company's beautifier

indicators.note: removed signals that letters are taken out of the beautifier word

parts.note: a cosmetic beautifies
CO is company, with the 's adding S

explanation.surface: An alien in residence takes a company's make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Greece a metic was a foreigner resident in a city, without citizen rights.

clue.text: Welcome for Cleveland favourite?

parts.note: Redcar is a seaside town in Cleveland, northeast England
a pet is a favourite

explanation.surface: A question about greeting a Cleveland, Ohio favourite.
explanation.walkthrough: Cleveland is not here the US city but the English county containing Redcar.
explanation.definitionFit: Rolling out a carpet is a lavish greeting for a dignitary, so a grand reception.

clue.text: Consequence of libel "Mum's getting long in the tooth"?

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, so mum; the 's is 'is', a link
to be getting long in the tooth is to grow old, so ages

explanation.surface: A family joke about mother looking older, framed as if it were a defamatory remark.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Mum's getting long in the tooth' as 'Dam ages'. The question mark hints that the libellous remark about Mum would itself bring the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A court awards money as compensation to someone who has been libelled, so this payout follows a successful libel case.

clue.text: Otologist, in a word, is not much fun

parts.note: an otologist is a doctor specialising in ears; DR is doctor
the ear part completes 'ear doctor' as one word

explanation.surface: An ear specialist, briefly put, is a dull person.
explanation.walkthrough: An otologist is an 'ear doctor', put as one word: DR and EAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreary or gloomy surroundings offer no enjoyment.

clue.text: Cheese put on by Hamlet

definitions.meaning: slang for a poor cheddar fit only for bait
the name Hamlet gives the play he stages for Claudius

explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet calls his play within the play by this name, and cheap cheddar is called it too.

clue.text: Sea beast good with tomcat (Manx)

parts.note: G is good

indicators.note: the Manx cat has no tail, so the cat word loses its last letter

parts.note: split in two: a tom is a male animal like a ram, and a cat is a puss

explanation.surface: A sea creature appears with a Manx tomcat.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's Manx tomcat is a tailless cat; 'Manx' here docks the last letter. A grampus is Risso's dolphin or the killer whale.
explanation.definitionFit: The killer whale or Risso's dolphin is called this, a large sea mammal.

clue.text: Shooter contains little sugar

indicators.note: contains places the small word inside the gun

parts.note: the Sten is a British gun
wee is Scottish for little

explanation.surface: A rifle has a little sugar inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To sugar food is to make it sweeter.

clue.text: Cover keeps little creature within bounds

indicators.note: a cover that keeps something holds it inside, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: a lid is a cover
a mite is a tiny creature

explanation.surface: A lid stops a tiny bug escaping from its container.
explanation.definitionFit: Something limited is restricted, kept inside set bounds rather than unlimited.

clue.text: Rival bird no longer with us

parts.note: the emu is a large flightless Australian bird
the late person is one who has died

explanation.surface: A competitor bird that has died.
explanation.definitionFit: To rival someone is to try to equal them, which is the sense of copying or matching their achievement.

clue.text: Conveyance for senior job at university?

indicators.note: the senior job is at the university, so the university's name comes first

parts.note: Bath is an English city with a university
a chair is a professorship, the senior academic post

explanation.surface: A question about a professorship at a particular university.
explanation.walkthrough: A bath chair is an old hooded wheelchair for invalids, named after the spa town of Bath.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a wheeled chair for invalids, so a means of carrying a person, a conveyance.

clue.text: Former partner, boy or girl, who is not at home

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
Pat can be short for Patrick or Patricia

explanation.surface: An ex-partner whose sex is unknown has moved away.
explanation.definitionFit: An expatriate lives abroad, away from the home country; the clue's relative phrase describes such a person.

clue.text: Reduce noise level with floor covering? It's all one to me

parts.note: sh is the command for quiet
a rug covers a floor

explanation.surface: Someone asked to hush and lie down a carpet replies they don't care.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the gesture itself: lifting the shoulders says 'I don't mind either way'.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising the shoulders signals indifference, the gesture that says nothing matters either way.

clue.text: Burrowing animal — ruin surrounds his head, immersed in drink

indicators.note: the inner part sits inside the drink

parts.note: grog is a rum drink

indicators.note: the ruin word surrounds the head letter

parts.note: undo means to ruin

indicators.note: the head of his is its first letter

explanation.surface: An animal is ruined, its head drowned in drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The woodchuck, a North American marmot, lives in burrows.

clue.text: See 17
Interesting condition for girl after lodger's gone round about

indicators.note: the girl comes after the rest
the lodger has gone round the short word

parts.note: PG is paying guest, a lodger
re means about
Nancy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl follows a lodger who has gone around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In an interesting condition' is an old euphemism for being pregnant.
explanation.definitionFit: An old euphemism for expecting a baby.

clue.text: The front page guy on "Drum" is round the bend — he got away with the bacon

annotationWithheld.why: The front page guy on "Drum" is round the bend — he got away with the bacon (3,3,3,6,3): TOM TOM is Drum and THE is The, but no parse found for PIPER'S SON from 'front page guy ... is round the bend'; no blog found
annotationWithheld.clue: The front page guy on "Drum" is round the bend — he got away with the bacon

clue.text: Asiatic and Greek character in metal

indicators.note: in means the Greek letter sits inside the metal's letters, enclosed by them

parts.note: tin is a metal
beta is a Greek letter

explanation.surface: An Asian with a Greek letter in metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tibetan is a person from Tibet, in Asia.

clue.text: Underground river included 3 over 22

indicators.note: included puts the river letter inside

parts.note: the maquis was the French wartime resistance underground
R is river

explanation.surface: A secret group includes a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 22 is BARON; a marquis ranks three places above (duke, marquis, earl, viscount, baron).
explanation.definitionFit: A marquis ranks three places above a baron in the peerage.

clue.text: Boy come to nothing when out

explanation.definitionFit: A boy's given name, and the verb in the phrasal 'peter out', meaning to fade away gradually.

clue.text: Pro in fit state is in three shapes

indicators.note: the pro is in the fit state

parts.note: trim is a fit condition
pro means for

explanation.surface: A fit professional has three forms.
explanation.definitionFit: Having three forms or shapes.

clue.text: Stink about silver with time for students to raise money

definitions.text: time for students to raise money

indicators.note: about places the reek around the rest

parts.note: a reek is a stink
AG is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A bad smell around silver.
explanation.walkthrough: Rag week is a British college fund-raising week of stunts.
explanation.definitionFit: Rag week is when students raise money for charity.

clue.text: Prohibition on beef?

parts.note: a bar is a ban or prohibition
taken as written

explanation.surface: A question whether meat-eating should be banned.
explanation.walkthrough: A baron of beef is a large joint of two sirloins; the question mark flags the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: A baron is a traditional double sirloin roast, a cut of beef.

clue.text: At home in sport, has contact with dots on I's and crosses on T's

definitions.text: dots on I's and crosses on T's

indicators.note: one word is put in the other

parts.note: fishing is a sport
to be in is to be at home
touches means has contact with

explanation.surface: A sports fan at home contacts the little marks on letters.
explanation.walkthrough: Dotting i's and crossing t's is the last tidying of handwriting, so the details that complete a job.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase 'dot the i's and cross the t's' means add final details, the last refinements that complete work.

clue.text: Particular female to head off brazen one

parts.note: F is female

indicators.note: head off means remove the first letter

parts.note: a hussy is a brazen woman

explanation.surface: A woman stops a shameless girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Fussy means particular, fastidious.

clue.text: The wrong American channel

parts.note: a sin is a wrong
US is American

explanation.surface: The bad American channel.
explanation.definitionFit: A sinus is a channel or cavity in the body.

clue.text: See 23
I haven't got my stripes: that was Dogberry's madness

definitions.meaning: the stripes of a non-commissioned officer have not come to me
Dogberry, the bumbling constable in Much Ado About Nothing, says this for a nonplussed state, mangling non compos mentis

explanation.definitionFit: A Shakespearean malapropism for being out of one's wits, and whimsically a stripe that has not arrived.

clue.text: Flowers, say, in number, say

indicators.note: the example goes in the following words

parts.note: taken as written
eg, for example, is what 'say' means

explanation.surface: A remark about flowers expressed as a number.
explanation.definitionFit: A posy is a small bunch of flowers, also called this old word.

clue.text: Cover for beast that eats cooked hams

indicators.note: the beast takes the other letters inside it as it eats them

parts.note: a yak is a Tibetan ox

indicators.note: cooked means the letters are prepared afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: An animal feeds on prepared ham meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' turns HAMS into ASHM, which the yak 'eats', giving Y-ASHM-AK.
explanation.definitionFit: A veil worn by some Muslim women covers the face.
